scope: Proposition 6.11 (Fixed-cover obstruction) of the manuscript “Log abundance in characteristic zero” (preprints/Log-abundance-in-characteristic-zero-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 87b191f75e8c8526), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Y be a projective Q-factorial terminal birational model of the counterexample X in Equation (10), and let Ti → Y , i = 1, 2, be fixed finite surjective morphisms from normal integral projective varieties. There is no integral parameter variety A0 and closed subvariety Γ ⊂ A0 × T1 × T2 flat over A0, with each fiber the integral graph of a birational map T1 99K T2, for which the projection Γ → T1 × T2 is dominant.
